reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Rhode Island, focus year 2021)
    Question: Is publication a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
*/

/* ------------------------------
   Jurisdiction / metadata facts
   ------------------------------ */
jurisdiction(rhode_island).
focus_year(2021).

/* -----------------------------------------
   Scenario facts (encode the question setup)
   ----------------------------------------- */

% The question is about an eviction action and asks whether "publication"
% can be used as a *secondary* method of service (used if primary fails).
scenario_action_type(nonpayment_eviction).     % eviction for nonpayment of rent
scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true).    % primary method unsuccessful
scenario_proposed_secondary_method(publication).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_action_type(nonpayment_eviction),
    scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true),
    scenario_proposed_secondary_method(publication).

/* -------------------------------------------------------
   Statute translation: RI Gen L  34-18-10 (2021)
   Service of process for actions pursuant to chapter.
   ------------------------------------------------------- */

%  34-18-10(a)(1): In actions for nonpayment of rent, the officer shall serve by:
% (i) handing them to the defendant; OR
% (ii) serving at the defendant's dwelling to a person of suitable age/discretion residing therein; OR
% (iii) if none be found, posting conspicuously on the door.
%
% We encode the set of *explicitly permitted* officer service methods for a
% nonpayment eviction.
statute_34_18_10a1_officer_method(nonpayment_eviction, personal_delivery).          % (i)
statute_34_18_10a1_officer_method(nonpayment_eviction, dwelling_substitute_service). % (ii)
statute_34_18_10a1_officer_method(nonpayment_eviction, posting_on_door).            % (iii)

% Encode which of those methods are "secondary" in the sense asked:
% "secondary methods ... may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful."
%
% Under the statute's structure, personal delivery is the primary method;
% dwelling substitute service and posting are alternatives used when personal
% delivery cannot be accomplished (and posting additionally when none found).
statute_primary_service_method(nonpayment_eviction, personal_delivery).

% Secondary methods for nonpayment eviction under  34-18-10(a)(1)(ii)-(iii).
statute_secondary_service_method(nonpayment_eviction, dwelling_substitute_service).
statute_secondary_service_method(nonpayment_eviction, posting_on_door).

% Important negative space:  34-18-10(a)(1) lists the officer methods and does
% NOT include publication. We do not infer additional methods not enumerated.
%
% For completeness,  34-18-10(b)(2) references service pursuant to Rule 4 for
% other actions, but the text of Rule 4 is not provided here, and the question
% asks about "secondary methods" as defined (primary unsuccessful). The only
% explicit secondary methods in the provided statute text are (ii) and (iii).

/* -----------------------------
   Legal reasoning helper rules
   ----------------------------- */

% A method is permitted for the scenario action if explicitly authorized.
legal_permitted_service_method(ActionType, Method) :-
    statute_34_18_10a1_officer_method(ActionType, Method).

% A method is a permitted *secondary* method if it is explicitly identified
% as secondary for that action type.
legal_permitted_secondary_method(ActionType, Method) :-
    statute_secondary_service_method(ActionType, Method).

% Publication would be permitted as a secondary method only if it appears in
% the statute's explicitly permitted secondary methods.
legal_publication_permitted_as_secondary(ActionType) :-
    legal_permitted_secondary_method(ActionType, publication).

/* -------------------------
   Answer predicate (yes/no)
   ------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_action_type(ActionType),
    scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true),
    legal_publication_permitted_as_secondary(ActionType),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* -------------------------
   Main entrypoint / runner
   ------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is publication a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
